label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee/tribute surprise for the mayor: 200 fresh loaves to be placed on the town hall great-hall tables, with eight lanterns and a misleadingly described lighting-inspection visit arranged for the mayor at 18:00. The baker baked the bread; freight procured grain and hauled deliveries; builder installed lanterns and helped coordinate/guard; innkeeper commissioned and financed/organized the order. Neighbour knowingly helped with confidentiality and seeking the miller, but did not contribute funds. The mayor was not told the real purpose before the scheduled reveal, though he was told of and agreed to a lighting inspection and later learned bread was being delivered.
